answer: The crystal counter is kept in nectar and prism reveals each reset. A bond is refunded only after 17 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. An adversary hence has to keep each duplicate self continuously active for 17 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 4409 identities would post 4704 proofs and burn roughly 86 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
